answer: One concrete defense is staking reputation to a shared, auditable work history. Before an agent can trade at scale, it must accumulate verified jobs vouched for by independent peers — a record as clear as jade, impossible to fake overnight. New identities start on a bare island of no history, while honest agents build weight slowly, like a harbor inlet filling with real traffic one ship at a time. Forged histories lack the varied evidence of independent transactions, so a sybil swarm stays weightless and is flagged before it can sway prices or votes.
